records.title: Development of Northern Ring Road for Tiruchirappalli.
details: a to e): As regard Ring Road of Tiruchirappalli, the DPR for southern part is awarded.

records.title: Status and Progress of Greenfield Highways
details: (a) & (b) The process for preparation of Detailed Project Report (DPR) has been initiated for (i) Karur - Coimbatore (ii) Chennai-Trichy-Madurai corridor and (iii) Trichy Ring Road.

records.title: Pitlines Facilities for Tiruchirappalli District
details: a to e: Further, construction of two additional Pit Lines for maintenance of MEMU rakes at Tiruchirappalli has been sanctioned at total cost of Rs61 Cr. and the work has been taken up.
